name: seasonal-themes
description: A colour theme for every month of the year, generated from the same season documents as the matching Oh My Posh prompts.

commands.title: Seasonal Themes: Use This Month's Theme

seasonalThemes.autoSwitch.description: When a Seasonal theme is active, switch to the current month's theme (and date variants like New Year's Eve) automatically.

enumDescriptions: Follow the operating system's light/dark setting (turns on window.autoDetectColorScheme and sets the preferred light and dark themes to this month's).
Light between seasonalThemes.lightFrom and seasonalThemes.darkFrom, dark the rest of the day.
seasonalThemes.mode.description: How to choose between the month's light and dark themes.

seasonalThemes.lightFrom.description: With mode 'time': when the light theme starts (24-hour HH:MM, local time).

seasonalThemes.darkFrom.description: With mode 'time': when the dark theme starts (24-hour HH:MM, local time).
